features.statement: Page is built from full-width stacked sections, each a centered block, rather than a main column plus sidebar.
Full-width section backgrounds alternate between cream and pale mint to separate content bands.
Page background is a warm off-white cream across the full width, with no dark surround.
Palette centers on a single saturated green accent, plus pale mint tints and dark slate-purple body text.
Headline and section headings are large, bold display sizes in a clear hierarchy, with the h1 in system sans.
Typography pairs a serif (Georgia) for accents and headings with a system sans-serif for UI and body.
Body text is slightly larger with generous line height, around 17px on 1.6 leading.
Headings use title or sentence case instead of all-caps.
Header is compact and translucent with backdrop blur, a small left logo, inline right-aligned text links and a thin hairline below.
Buttons and chips are fully rounded pills, in filled green primary and outlined secondary variants.
Hero is centered with an intro paragraph, a pill search bar with suggestion chips, and two CTA buttons.
Filter pills sit above content grids to let users narrow items by category.
List content is shown as responsive multi-column card grids with rounded corners and an accent left border.
Statistics appear as separate cards with large green numerals instead of small badge lists.
Links to articles appear as bordered cards with serif text and a trailing green arrow.
Pagination is replaced by outlined call-to-action buttons with arrows, such as 'See more' and 'Random'.
Each section pairs a heading with a short descriptive subtitle and a call-to-action button, in a two-column text-and-image layout where useful.
Content is wrapped in semantic section elements with a clean heading outline, one h1 followed by named h2s.
Uses real button elements for actions and a lean DOM with few scripts and a small custom class vocabulary.
Layout relies heavily on flexbox and grid, with a taller, airier page and generous whitespace.
Image alt text is descriptive of the image content rather than a site name or URL.
Illustrations are shown as separate rounded tiles or cards rather than large headers, and the footer is light.
Icons are small glyphs inside pill chips, with arrow characters used as text affordances instead of SVG or icon fonts.
Tone is calmer and more inviting, with fewer exclamation marks and a signature line in italic serif with an em dash.
Page title uses a domain name followed by an em dash and a descriptive phrase.
Long words in narrow cards can wrap or break mid-word, creating awkward line breaks.
Icons in social or link chips can be mismatched with their labels, with reused icons.
